old_description: Founded in 1989, G5 TEXTILE GROUP is a global manufacturing company specializing in apparel and textiles. We supply clothing to major brands worldwide, prioritizing quality and innovation. Our strong values, integrity, and dedication have built trusted relationships with customers, suppliers, and partners.
about:
G5 Textile Group was founded in 1989 in St Cloud, Florida, by Eddie, who serves as CEO and founder. The company began as a global manufacturing operation specializing in apparel and textiles, supplying clothing to major brands worldwide.

The company designs and produces custom-made garments at scale through a network of manufacturing facilities in the United States, El Salvador, China, and Colombia. Its "Smart Manufacture" approach blends advanced technology with customization, supported by an online platform that lets clients customize designs, process orders, and manage custom production. The facilities are equipped for high-volume output while emphasizing eco-friendly materials, energy-efficient technologies, and waste reduction practices.

G5 serves the fashion, athletic wear, and branded merchandise sectors. Its customer base includes professional sports organizations such as the Orlando Magic, for which it produces in-house department uniforms, as well as educational institutions like JPETROV Academy and white-label fashion partners such as TeamIP, which has collaborated for five years on innovative fashion products.

The company states that its differentiation lies in combining innovation, efficiency, and sustainability. It aims to cut production costs and time without sacrificing quality, leveraging global production coordination and a technology-driven customization platform to deliver cost-effective, personalized garment manufacturing.

name: GAMA Electronics Plant 2
old_description: Fifty miles northwest of Chicago where industry and agriculture share the spotlight the phrase “Made in America” means business! We are a full service electronic products manufacturer. We have the industrial muscle and technical ingenuity you need to execute a winning project.
about:
GAMA Electronics was founded in 1990 by John and Irene Golbeck in Woodstock, Illinois, about fifty miles northwest of Chicago. The family-owned business continues to be managed by the founders along with their son, Tom. From its inception, the company positioned itself as a full-service electronic products manufacturer serving customers worldwide.

The company designs and manufactures electromechanical and electronic controls, including custom electronic assemblies, switches, control panels, and wireless remote controls. Its Woodstock facility handles both through-hole and surface-mount PCB assembly, mechanical assembly, wire harnessing, and packaging, with production rates ranging from low-volume to high-volume sustained runs. In-house design capabilities span circuit and PCB layout, software development, and mechanical design for sheet metal, injection-molded plastics, graphical overlays, and control panels. Prototyping is performed internally to validate designs before tooling. Global manufacturing alliances supplement U.S. production.

GAMA serves the transportation, industrial equipment, medical, agricultural, and marine markets. In transportation, it produces patented battery disconnect switches and high-volume cruise control switch assemblies for a major U.S. automotive manufacturer. Industrial customers use motor controls, access controls, remote controls, HVAC controls, gymnasium equipment controls, winch and hoist controls, and lighting controls. Medical work includes a line of heat sealers and custom assemblies for X-ray machinery, pharmaceutical dispensing equipment, and patient assist devices. Agricultural applications feature remote control systems, motor control assemblies, and custom control panels.

The company emphasizes a family-oriented workplace culture, stating that happy employees lead to satisfied customers. Its ISO 9001 certification underpins quality assurance, while the combination of a modern U.S. facility and global partnerships aims to deliver competitive pricing and timely delivery. A focus on research and development means the product portfolio reflects both current offerings and engineering capabilities.

name: GAO RFID
old_description: GAO RFID Inc. is a leading provider of cutting-edge RFID solutions. With 3 decades of expertise, GAO RFID Inc. designs and manufactures advanced RFID products that empower businesses to optimize operations, enhance security, and improve overall efficiency. Our innovative technology solutions are trusted by organizations across various industries, including logistics, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing.
about:
GAO RFID Inc., a member of the GAO Group, is headquartered in Toronto, Canada, with a U.S. office in New York City. The company has over 30 years of experience in RFID and BLE technologies, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. It operates as a privately held corporation incorporated in both Canada and the United States.

The company designs and manufactures a broad range of RFID and BLE hardware, including readers, tags, antennas, printers, and gateways covering low frequency, high frequency, ultra-high frequency, active, and Bluetooth Low Energy spectra. Its software portfolio centers on a proprietary middleware platform that can be customized into industry-specific applications, cloud services, and reporting tools. GAO RFID also provides consulting, site surveys, system integration, and technical support. To date, it has deployed more than 11,000 RFID and BLE systems across over 70 countries.

Customers range from small and mid-sized enterprises to Fortune 500 companies, educational institutions, and government agencies. The company serves industries such as healthcare, agriculture, oil and gas, manufacturing, logistics, transportation, retail, automotive, railway, livestock management, education, data centers, warehousing, and cold-chain monitoring.

GAO RFID emphasizes three differentiators: overnight delivery from local warehouses within the continental U.S. and Canada, expert support with onsite capability, and hardware that is expertly designed, manufactured, and tested in-house. Its team includes CompTIA RFID+ certified professionals who assist from initial consultation through deployment and long-term maintenance.

name: GEM EQUIPMENT OF OREGON INC
old_description: Since 1968, GEM Equipment of Oregon, Inc. has been at the forefront of custom food processing equipment, specializing in advanced frying systems. From French fries to a wide variety of fried foods, we design, build, and install the industry's largest and most reliable fryers and blanchers. As part of FPS Food Process Solutions—a global leader in turnkey food processing—we deliver integrated solutions for fried food production worldwide, supported by the FPS family of companies including Charlottetown Metal Products (CMP) and Total Solutions Limited (TSL).
about:
GEM Equipment of Oregon, Inc. was founded in 1968 in Woodburn, Oregon, by co‑founder Ed McKenney. Starting with limited resources but a clear vision to deliver equipment that meets real‑world processing needs through close collaboration with customers, the company quickly became a key supplier to major food processors. In 2023, GEM was acquired by FPS Food Process Solutions, joining a global family of companies that includes Charlottetown Metal Products and Total Solutions Limited.

The company designs, builds, and installs custom food‑processing equipment, specializing in advanced frying systems. Its product range includes fryers, blanchers, and batter applicators, offered as standalone machines or fully integrated processing lines. Engineering relies on computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modelling to optimize oil flow, and equipment is constructed from stainless steel for durability. GEM also provides a global service network with remote diagnostics, maintenance, and retrofit services.

GEM serves food manufacturers worldwide, with a focus on fried‑food production. Its customer base includes major processors such as General Foods, Ore‑Ida, Simplot, McCain Foods, and Lamb Weston. Applications span potato processing (French fries), seafood, vegetable, snack‑food, and malting operations.

The company’s operating philosophy centers on three principles: lowest total cost of ownership over a ten‑year horizon, exceptional service with urgent field response, and continuous improvement through design and manufacturing enhancements. CFD expertise that eliminates recirculation zones and heat spots is cited as a key differentiator, along with easy access to critical components for efficient sanitation and changeovers.

name: GRK Manufacturing Co
old_description: GRK Manufacturing came into being in May of 1988 when Gary R. Kilday and family formed a corporation to purchase the assets of the Manual Arts Furniture Company. Manual Arts – or MAFCO as it was known – had a long history starting in 1915 as the only piano bench maker for the Baldwin Piano Company of downtown Cincinnati. Baldwin was a major provider of pianos in the United States and it turned to two “shop” teachers – manual arts teachers – to be their makers of piano benches. MAFCO provided Baldwin’s benches for almost 50 years.
about:
GRK Manufacturing Co. is based in Hamilton, Ohio. The company was formed in May 1988 when Gary R. Kilday and his family incorporated to acquire the assets of the Manual Arts Furniture Company (MAFCO), a business that began in 1915 as the exclusive piano bench supplier for the Baldwin Piano Company of Cincinnati. MAFCO had held that role for nearly five decades before its sudden closure.

Today GRK operates a woodworking and sewing facility in Hamilton, a location secured in 1992. The shop produces piano benches, piano covers, and bench cushions, while the woodworking side turns out doors, retail and grocery store fixtures, mirror frames, and components for agricultural tripods. The company also sources and sells imported piano benches and dollies. The sewing division has expanded from a single part‑time seamstress to three full‑time staff, and the woodworking team continues to take on custom projects across multiple product lines.

GRK serves the musical instrument industry (piano benches, covers, cushions), furniture makers, retail and grocery fixture suppliers, and agricultural equipment manufacturers. Historical customers include the Baldwin Piano Company and the Nutone Company (mirror frames), along with a North Carolina firm that bought solid oak tables. Current music‑industry clients purchase both domestically made and imported benches and dollies.

The business was originally created to preserve MAFCO’s manufacturing legacy after its abrupt shutdown. Diversification into non‑music woodwork allowed the company to survive, and in 2023 former Operations Manager Rob Vicena purchased the assets to continue that trajectory. GRK emphasizes its willingness to accept new woodworking and sewing challenges as a core reason for its ongoing growth.

about:
Galaxy Electronics Inc. is a family-owned contract electronics manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. The company traces its roots to 1993 when it began specializing in full-service manufacturing of printed circuit boards, control panels, electromechanical assemblies, cable assemblies, and wiring harnesses. According to the company's history, it was formally founded in 1999 as a garage operation repairing printed circuit boards.

Today Galaxy Electronics provides full-service contract manufacturing including through-hole and surface-mount PCB assembly, mixed-technology board assembly, conformal coating, cable and wire harness fabrication, electromechanical and control panel assembly, box build and final assembly, custom kitting, software installation, functional testing, and turnkey procurement of enclosures and components. The company handles prototype runs through large-volume production and offers both turnkey and consignment assembly models.

Its customer base spans automotive, medical, drilling and oil rig contractors, electric utilities, telecommunications, computers, data processing, and general industrial equipment. The company works with startups bringing first products to market as well as established manufacturers seeking a dependable production partner.

Galaxy Electronics emphasizes its engineering-degreed ownership and a staff with over 40 combined years of hands-on experience, ISO 9001 certification, ITAR registration, and a commitment to quick turnaround times backed by equipment such as an APS nova star wave solder machine and automated wire processing systems. The family-owned culture drives a focus on personal communication, proactive issue flagging, and on-time delivery.

old_description: Every chair in Gary Platt’s collection of performance casino seating is hand-crafted to perfection, bringing unsurpassed comfort to each player’s gaming experience. With more than 40 years in delivering state-of-the-art ergonomically sculpted performance casino seating, Gary Platt’s X-Tended Play and the X2– Tended Play series continue to push the bounds of excellence. about:
Gary Platt Seating, based in Sparks, Nevada, has been delivering performance casino seating for more than 40 years. The company remains privately held, though ownership details are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The company hand-crafts a range of casino chairs, including the Kiara, Genesis, Lido Revo, Monaco, Bella, Sedona, Kopa, Savannah, Lugano, San Remo, Sonoma Club, and Tesla models. Each chair incorporates proprietary high-density foam and ergonomically sculpted frames, with several designs protected by U.S. design patents such as Monaco D829458 and the Tesla wing-back. Manufacturing includes custom upholstery selection from a library of leathers, fabrics, vinyls, and polyurethanes, as well as powder-coated, anodized, or plated base finishes, edge molding, and optional insert handles.

Gary Platt Seating serves casino operators worldwide, outfitting gaming floors, high-limit areas, poker rooms, dealer stations, keno and bingo halls, bar seating, and table-game positions such as baccarat, blackjack, and roulette. Its chairs are specified for both player and dealer comfort, with configurations for pedestal or leg bases.

The company emphasizes that its hand-crafted construction, proprietary foam, and patented ergonomic designs combine to extend player time-on-device and deliver a blend of functionality and durability that distinguishes its seating in the casino market.
